scope: first-order numeric estimators and phase-wrapped signals

capabilities.units: declared per column and checked before values
capabilities.shape: declared row/column shape and checked before values
capabilities.state: explicit previous-output state with documented update order
capabilities.dynamic_response: full trace compared, including first step, peak and final values
capabilities.phase_boundaries: [-pi, pi) wrap including +/-pi and near-boundary angles
capabilities.golden_truth: deterministic synthetic truth plus measured baseline
capabilities.tolerance: atol/rtol frozen in the BehaviorContract before apply

verification.statistical_test: unsupported in R1; no p-value claim

limitations: MATLAB semantics are not a release promise
real recorded user data requires explicit authorization
statistical and ULP comparison modes are not implemented
